rv.q: If you love animals or love an animal lover, The Dog Show will entertain and bring joy.
Beneath the punch lines, the production finds something affectionate and familiar in the bond between dogs and people.

Playwright David Javerbaum's experience as an executive producer and head writer of "The Daily Show with Jon Stewart" shows as he infuses a razor-sharp wit into bite-sized, easily digestible dialogue.

cn.t: Critics praise this inventive 75-minute comedy that gives dogs a voice through rapid-fire monologues, with Emmy-winner David Javerbaum's sharp comic writing earning positive marks across the board.
